verdict.rationale: Raygun documents source map decoding that turns minified JavaScript errors into readable traces with source snippets. Maps can be fetched automatically, or uploaded manually through the JS source map center or an API authenticated with an external access token. That API is a first-party upload path a CI job could call, but the pack documents no official CLI or bundler plugin, which is the specific CI mechanism the story asks for. Missing for 10: an official upload CLI, bundler plugins (webpack/Vite etc.), documented CI workflow examples, independent hands-on corroboration.
